gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all project categories to organize my projects effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all project categories with their respective IDs and names.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new project category to better classify my projects.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a category name and return the created category's ID and details.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete a project category that is no longer needed.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified project category and return a success message.

gold.user: As a team member, I want to get details of a specific project category to understand its purpose.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified project category, including its name and associated projects.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to update the name of an existing project category to reflect recent changes.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated category name and return the updated category's details.
